findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "We Fill Your Calendar With 20+ Qualified Sales M" → 6 lines (16 words, 62px); "We don't just send you leads. We build the machi" → 5 lines (14 words, 54px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: Hero headline is 16 words ("We Fill Your Calendar With 20+ Qualified Sales Meetings in 3"). Gallery median is 5.
findings.fix: Say the one thing. Move the rest to the supporting line.

findings.message: 3 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Run the numbers" above "Here's what our done-for-you GTM system "; "Simple, performance-based pricing" above "Pay for booked appointments."; "Our promise to you" above "20 qualified meetings in 30 days. Guaran"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 10 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Done-for-you outbound. A fully managed g", "Trusted by teams like", "Run the numbers", "Stage").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 6 gradient fill(s): section.hero.section-dark → radial-gradient(circle at 10% 10%, rgba(180, 124, 240, 0.34), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 28%), linear-gradient(135deg, r | div.glow.glow-one → linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(138, 64, 234) 0%, rgb(180, 124, 240) 100%) | div.glow.glow-two → linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(138, 64, 234) 0%, rgb(180, 124, 240) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 43 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.btn.btn-primary → rgba(138, 64, 234, 0.3) 0px 16px 36px 0px | div.embed-frame.canva-frame → rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18) 0px 0px 0px 1px, rgba(138, 64, 234, 0.38) 0px 30px 90p | article.pain-card → rgba(75, 29, 143, 0.14) 0px 22px 70px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with gradient fill and shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 2 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): section#pricing.section.section-tint 1440px | div.container.copyright 1160px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 2 box(es) drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Prefer a filled surface or no box.

findings.message: 2 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (4 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Indigo / violet (text #4b1d8f).
findings.fix: Use the accent from the drawn palette.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (5.6:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 1 text block(s) under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 62px (4.3vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.
